ref: IMG_4440 contact-sheet f030 ('-5' close, squared up on the 5), f021 and IMG_4442 f009 (whole word, very oblique / far)
notes: Lowercase 'hi-5' in lime-green flat-cut acrylic (about 3 cm, glossy, unlit) on the light warm-grey fascia band of a candy/snack shop (black storefront, Red Bull and candy inside). Only the '-5' is seen close (sheet f030): a condensed squared 5 with a straight stem, square bowl and up-turned tail, matched by Saira Extra Condensed Bold; 'hi' is only seen edge-on (f021) and far (4442 f009) as two narrow uprights, so its letterforms are the font's. The check box is fitted on the 5 only (the 'hi' falls off the left of the reference). Cap height ~0.55 m guessed from the band; the word is small, about 1 m wide.
